correctness.rationale: The primary PDF visually confirms that Eq. (19) is followed by “increasingly ordered eigenvalues”. Uhlmann Proposition 4.1 uses the same roof with nonincreasing order. The literal ascending convention forces the expression nonpositive for every rank at least two. Independently, the Bell-white-noise spectrum gives corrected value \(\max\{0,(3p-1)/2\}\); at \(p=1/2\) exact arithmetic gives \(1/4\), while ascending order gives zero.
